_about: Source of truth for the Steam achievements and stats (Assets/CarpetCleaning/Docs/ACHIEVEMENTS.md). The ORDER of 'achievements' is the order they must be created in Steamworks (App Admin > Stats & Achievements > Achievements): Steamworks names the localization tokens NEW_ACHIEVEMENT_3_<index>_NAME/_DESC by creation order (block 3: the two stats took IDs 1 and 2; checked against the download on 2026-09-30), and Scripts/Steam/Achievements.cs AchievementId uses the same indices. Append only; never reorder. 'note' and 'terms' are for translators: 'terms' lists in-game strings (keys of Assets/CarpetCleaning/Localization/Resources/Loc/<code>.json) whose existing translation the achievement text must reuse. Translations live in loc/<code>.json (game language codes, Tools/loc/loc_tool.py LANGS). Build: python Tools/Steam/achievements.py check && python Tools/Steam/achievements.py build

stats.note: Number of bits in SaveData.toolsUsed. Progress stat of ACH_FULL_KIT (0..10).

achievements.name: First Fluff
achievements.emblem: a single small rug with fringe
achievements.note: Unlocks when the player hands over (gives back to the client) their first cleaned carpet. 'First Fluff' is a pun on 'fluff' (the carpet pile gets fluffy again; the game is called Refluff): a short, warm title, translate the idea (first fluffy carpet) rather than word for word.

achievements.name: Spotless
achievements.desc: Hand over a dirty carpet 100% clean.
achievements.emblem: cream sparkle with a small second sparkle
achievements.note: The pay slip calls a 100% clean carpet 'Spotless' (a bonus line); use the same word as the game for the title. 'dirty' = any carpet that was not already spotless when it arrived.

achievements.name: Bone Dry
achievements.desc: Soak a carpet, then hand it over 100% dry.
achievements.note: The pay slip calls a 100% dry carpet 'Bone dry' (a bonus line); use the same expression as the game for the title (title case in English only). 'Soak' = get the carpet really wet with water (hose, foam) before drying it.

achievements.name: Showroom Finish
achievements.desc: Hand over a dirty carpet 100% clean and 100% dry.
achievements.emblem: gold coin medal with a star
achievements.note: This is the pay slip's 'Combo' (100% clean + 100% dry at once). 'Showroom Finish' = the carpet looks as if it came straight from a shop display: new-looking, flawless. Find a natural idiom for 'looks brand new / display-ready'.

achievements.name: Filthy to Fluffy
achievements.desc: Hand over a Filthy carpet 100% clean.
achievements.note: 'Filthy' is the pay slip's label for the dirtiest class of carpet (after Light soil, Medium soil, Heavy soil): use exactly the game's word for 'Filthy' in the description. The title is an alliterative before/after pun (filthy -> fluffy); keep it short and playful, alliteration is welcome but not required.

achievements.name: Express Service
achievements.desc: Earn the full speed bonus on a heavily soiled carpet.
achievements.note: The pay slip has a 'Speed bonus' line that pays in full when the carpet is handed over within the par time. 'heavily soiled' = the pay slip's 'Heavy soil' or 'Filthy' classes: echo the game's 'Heavy soil' wording. 'Express Service' = a fast premium cleaning service, as a company would advertise it.

achievements.name: Regular Customers
achievements.note: The player runs a small carpet-cleaning business; after 25 carpets the clients keep coming back. Keep the number 25 as digits.

achievements.name: Every Tool in the Van
achievements.note: The game has 10 tools (8 for the carpet, 2 for the floor). A professional carpet cleaner carries the kit in a van: the title means 'you have used everything you own'. Keep the number 10 as digits.

achievements.name: Maxed Out
achievements.desc: Upgrade one tool's POWER and AREA to MAX.
achievements.note: In the Upgrades shop every tool has two tracks, POWER and AREA, each up to the level shown as MAX. Both tracks of the SAME tool must reach MAX. Use the game's exact translations of POWER, AREA and MAX (keep them uppercase if the game does).

achievements.name: Inspector
achievements.desc: Buy the Moisture highlight and the Dirt highlight.
achievements.note: The two one-time items in the INSPECTION section of the Upgrades shop. Use the game's exact names for 'Moisture highlight' and 'Dirt highlight'. 'Inspector' = someone who inspects a job for quality.
